goal: Evaluate and hold a bounded comparison metadata batching prototype when native callback equivalence remains unqualified.
procedure: Read the current comparison metadata and registered source/raw algorithms. Preserve fresh artifact validation first. Prototype a tagged UNION ALL read for its two exact nominated keys, reject ambiguous or mismatched rows, recheck native bindings after SQL, and replay existing decoders without grants or retained rows. Run only focused controlled component checks. Independently review native callback equivalence. The reviewer reproduced custom Cursor execute/fetchall/constructor eligibility and identified custom connection adapter loader/dumper effects; the selected connection also uses a generated XTDB string dumper. Local constructor, JSON, access, copy and function fingerprints did not qualify those driver effects. HOLD rather than broaden the audit. Remove the runtime prototype and new tests, retaining only this public method note and seed. Preserve the original committed sequential runtime; keep the prototype patch explicitly unpublished.
authority: The held prototype is not shipped and grants no source use, private access, provider disclosure or producer qualification. Actual current owner permissions, canonical Experience and independently qualified control ports remain authoritative in the unchanged sequential runtime.
validation: The pre-hold prototype passed 18 focused component checks; a final cursor-exclusion regression raised the local count to 19. Actual registry decoders used explicitly controlled rows; native static classification used unconnected typed handles with no RPCs. This established row mechanics and local rejection cases only. Independent review reproduced cursor overrides still classified native before the added exclusion and identified unqualified custom adapter callback ordering. Prior controlled attribution was 694 metadata calls/1388 source/raw statements; the physical aggregate contains 1807 metadata calls with no eligibility counter. Neither attribution establishes an actual saving. No runtime pair or prototype tests are published, and no physical eligibility, query reduction, callback equivalence or latency win is claimed.
failure_or_lesson: Native receiver and method identities do not prove effect-free metadata reads. Batching moves raw retrieval before source reconstruction and changes driver callback order/count; custom cursor implementations and adapter loaders/dumpers can violate sequential effects. If qualifying the actual per-connection configuration exceeds the bounded seam, hold and preserve the original path rather than infer safety from fewer statements or passing controlled mechanics.
